messages.user: Write Julia function solve(keys, values). Return a Vector of Pair mapping each distinct key to the sum of its values, preserving FIRST occurrence order of keys. Inputs have equal length; keys are strings, values are Int. Empty input must return an empty vector. No packages. Code only.

answer:
```julia
function solve(keys, values)
    if isempty(keys)
        return Pair{String,Int}[]
    end
    
    # Track first occurrence order
    order = String[]
    seen = Set{String}()
    sums = Dict{String,Int}()
    
    for (k, v) in zip(keys, values)
        if !(k in seen)
            push!(order, k)
            push!(seen, k)
            sums[k] = 0
        end
        sums[k] += v
    end
    
    return [Pair(k, sums[k]) for k in order]
end
```
